main_text.l: Causalis, ut γὰρ enim, ἐπειδὴ quo-
niam, ὅτι quód, διότι & καὶ ὅτι propterea

page.notes: The Greek words are printed with accents and breathings; some are doubtful in the scan (ὄφελ, ἐπειδὴ, ἄρα). The chapter opens with a large woodcut initial P, joined to "RIMA". The title block lines are rendered as a single head; the printed line breaks are not preserved.
